{{samename|episode of ''Pokémon Horizons: The Series'' titled ''The Ancient Poké Ball''|HZ006}} ---- [[File:Roy Ancient Poké Ball anime.png|thumb|250px|An Ancient Poké Ball in {{aniseries|HZ}}]] The '''Ancient Poké Ball''' (Japanese: '''いにしえのモンスターボール''' ''Ancient {{tt|Monster Ball|Poké Ball}}'') is a 100-year-old type of [[Poké Ball]] that appears in {{aniseries|HZ}}. The search for these Poké Balls is an important plot within ''Pokémon Horizons: The Series''. The only known Ancient Poké Balls belonged to the Ancient Adventurer [[Lucius]], who used them to capture the members of the [[Six Heroes]]. In addition to capturing Pokémon, they seem to have unique powers and react to certain stimuli such as [[Pagogo]]'s [[Terastal energy]] and even each other. They were also shown to be opened differently than other Poké Balls. ==History== Ancient Poké Balls were used before the modern ones at least 100 years ago. The Ancient Adventurer [[Lucius]] is the only known {{pkmn|Trainer}} to have owned these Poké Balls, as he used them to catch his Pokémon, the [[Six Heroes]]. After reaching the Pokémon paradise [[Laqua]], an incident caused by [[Gibeon]]'s fascination with [[Laquium]] resulted in the Six Heroes being scattered around the {{pkmn|world}} with their respective Ancient Poké Balls. One of them washed up on the shoreline of [[Roy's hometown|an island]] in [[Kanto]], where it was found by [[Roy's grandfather|a man]], who later passed it down to his grandson, [[Roy]]. The first Ancient Poké Ball appeared in ''[[HZ004|The Treasure After the Storm!]]'', under Roy's ownership, who mentioned that he had never managed to open it. In ''[[HZ006|The Ancient Poké Ball]]'', the ball reacted with [[Liko]]'s [[Pagogo|pendant]] and opened, revealing the [[Black Rayquaza]], who flew away soon after. The [[Rising Volt Tacklers]]'s travels led Liko and Roy to find the other five Ancient Poké Balls in different regions: two in [[Paldea]], one in [[Galar]], one in [[Kitakami]], and another at [[Lapras Sea|sea]]. In ''[[HZ089|Where the Adventure Leads]]'', after Lucius passed away, all of his Pokémon were automatically {{pkmn2|released}} from their Ancient Poké Balls. As the Rising Volt Tacklers fled from the havoc caused by the Six Heroes affected by [[Laquium]], the Ancient Poké Balls, alongside Lucius's diary and belt, were lost in a fissure created as a result of their vicious battle.
